design: Metadata is a fresh ordered plain record. Private typed-field readers preserve in-presence, inherited properties, one property read, exact typeof admission, phased nullish/truthy fallbacks, strict-true truncation and permissive number facts.
Notification reports use native entries iteration, serialize each encountered candidate before budget admission, charge the final newline, always admit the first line and read count after iteration.
Manifest reports use native values iteration with the eight-item guard inside the loop, preserving the ninth fetch boundary, then return the current count and clipped previews.
The original serializer binding is imported and re-exported directly. No competing serializer, state, policy, async boundary, catch, retry, mutation, live operation or framework was introduced.

current_task_access.read_phases: The exact four packet files were read together for authoring and reread only for SHA256 binding. Owned source artifacts were read only for their source hashes.
current_task_access.writes: Only the two owned initial sources, SHA256SUMS, accessed-inputs.json and author-record.json in draft-01. These artifacts were made read-only after sealing.
current_task_access.excluded: No predecessor/current production source, history, tests, evidence outside the four packet files, oracles, receipts, compiled bodies, dependency implementations, git data, or other repository files were read.
current_task_access.operations: Only shell filesystem packet/artifact reads and writes, clock recording, hashing and artifact permission changes. No live task, notification, process, artifact, provider, user-file, model, network, permission or business operation; no extra agents/tasks or settings changes.

inherited_context.retained: Prior packet contents, author draft content, outcome reports and parent functional clarifications remain in this reused conversation/executor.
inherited_context.limits: Prior source/draft files were not reopened or revised during this assignment. Access restrictions were instruction-bound on a shared filesystem, not enforced isolation. No absolute packet-only, clean-room, licence, independence or originality assertion is made.
inherited_context.settings: Existing parent-reported model/reasoning/Fast settings were retained without query or change.

validation.pre_seal_checks: None. No compiler, tests, authored code execution, formatting or source comparison was run.
validation.initial_preservation: Both complete initial sources were saved before hashing and curator comparison. No in-place source edits occurred after their initial write, and no post-seal revision is included.
validation.next_boundary: Stop after reporting sealed hashes; curator owns any subsequent comparison and validation.
